findings.summary: Linked branches lose their repository identity, so branches in forks are not reused correctly.
findings.failure_scenario: An issue has a linked branch in a fork, created with gh issue develop --branch-repo. The script keeps only its name with cut -f1, then invokes gh issue develop without --branch-repo. This targets the issue's repository instead, creating an unrelated branch there or failing on permissions or an existing name, rather than checking out the linked branch.

findings.summary: A comment failure leaves a committed body edit that is duplicated or refused on retry.
findings.failure_scenario: The issue edit succeeds, but the following comment request fails or times out. The script exits unsuccessfully although the finding has already been appended. Retrying the same command appends the finding again when the host previously had zero additions; when it previously had one, the retry refuses the now-full host and instructs the caller to file a new issue for an already-recorded finding.
